content.text: You are watching a robotic gripper completing a task from the viewpoint of its wrist camera. Several colored trajectories are overlaid on the screen. Which of these trajectories will result in the robot correctly unplugging the charger from the power strip and placing it to the right? Choices:  A. The orange trajectory. B. The red trajectory. C. The purple trajectory. D. The yellow trajectory. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
